review.tagline: Slash-command skill pack that turns Claude Code into a role-based engineering team
review.summary: gstack is a set of Markdown skills and helper tools, installed with a setup script, that give Claude Code slash commands for product review, planning, code review, browser QA, security audits and shipping PRs. It also installs for Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, Kiro and other agents, with Claude Code the only host rated full and the rest experimental or instruction-only. Setup builds a bundled browser binary and needs Bun.
review.audience: Claude Code users wanting structured review, QA and release workflows
strengths: Covers plan, review, QA, security audit and ship steps as slash commands
Installs for about 8 agent hosts via `./setup --host`
Team mode adds gstack to a repo so teammates get it automatically
MIT license; skills are plain Markdown and can be forked
weaknesses: Only Claude Code is certified; other hosts are experimental, with advisory-only safety skills
Requires Bun 1.4.2+ (setup refuses older than 1.3.3) and a Chromium download
/cso needs a specific Bun build and native C toolchain, else reports not assessed
Outside reviews and design tools need Codex CLI or an OpenAI API key
needs: Needs Claude Code, Git, Bun, Node.js (Windows only), Codex CLI (outside reviews), OpenAI API key (design binary)
Models: Claude (Opus 5.5), OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol), gpt-5.5, gpt-image-2
